findings.description: Git commit author identity vs. Organizational Change Owner terminology ambiguity.
findings.remediation_action: Explicitly decouple Git author/committer identity from organizational Change Owner role in Phase 87.24 documentation.
Document signing readiness and constraints; maintain explicit unverified status without breaking workflows.

findings.description: Deployment eligibility matrix pass criteria listed APPROVED_UNVERIFIED as verified.
findings.remediation_action: Correct matrix pass criteria to enforce fail-closed distinction (APPROVED_UNVERIFIED is not satisfied).

findings.description: Change Owner organizational authority lacks independent HR/charter verification.
findings.remediation_action: Retain APPROVED_UNVERIFIED status until formal organizational sign-off is established.

findings.description: Zabbix API transport utilizes plaintext HTTP without formal security exception sign-off.
findings.remediation_action: Retain HTTP_SECURITY_EXCEPTION_PENDING and require formal InfoSec sign-off.
